description: This file defines the ContextDAO interface for OpenMRS, outlining methods for user authentication, session management, cache operations, system startup and shutdown, search index updates, and database connections within the OpenMRS core system.

classes.name: ContextDAO
classes.description: Interface defining database access functions in OpenMRS, including user authentication, session management, cache management, system lifecycle, search indexing, and connection handling.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticate user with username and password, returning a User object if successful or throwing an exception if authentication fails.

methods.name: getUserByUuid
methods.description: Retrieve a User by its UUID; privilege checks are not performed.

methods.name: getUserByUsername
methods.description: Retrieve a User by username; privilege checks are not performed.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Create a new user with specified roles and password, potentially used when managed by external authentication providers.

methods.name: openSession
methods.description: Open a database session.

methods.name: closeSession
methods.description: Close the current database session.

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Clear the current session, removing cached objects.

methods.name: flushSession
methods.description: Flush session changes to the database.

methods.name: evictFromSession
methods.description: Remove a specific object from the session cache.

methods.name: evictEntity
methods.description: Evict a specific entity from the cache.

methods.name: evictAllEntities
methods.description: Evict all entities of a specific class from cache.

methods.name: clearEntireCache
methods.description: Clear all cache regions.

methods.name: refreshEntity
methods.description: Re-read the state of the object from the database.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Initialize the system with provided properties.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Stop the system, performing cleanup.

methods.name: mergeDefaultRuntimeProperties
methods.description: Merge default properties for database connection.

methods.name: setupSearchIndex
methods.description: Update the search index if needed.

methods.name: updateSearchIndex
methods.description: Update the search index synchronously.

methods.name: updateSearchIndexAsync
methods.description: Update the search index asynchronously.

methods.name: updateSearchIndexForObject
methods.description: Update search index for a specific object.

methods.name: updateSearchIndexForType
methods.description: Update search index for a specific class type.

methods.name: updateSearchIndex
methods.description: Update search index for multiple types.

methods.name: getDatabaseConnection
methods.description: Get a connection object from the database pool.
